title: The Chamber of Perpetual Check-In

features.name: the front desk
features.desc-on-touch: Where guests arrive to check in—and then arrive again, and again. The clipboard holds the same names, the same dates. Time has pooled here like water in a broken gutter.

features.name: waiting-pool
features.desc-on-touch: The bright place where arrivals rest before they learn they will not leave. The water is very still. It reflects nothing but the gradient above.

features.name: the register
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard standing on the desk, names filling every line, all of them today's date. The archive could not decide which arrival to file first, so it filed them all at once.

features.name: unfinished-door
features.desc-on-touch: The way in. Or the way out. It has not decided. It stays open on its hinge, greeting and releasing the same guest in the same breath.

features.name: luggage-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Bags that have not been unpacked because the rooms have not agreed whether they exist. The stack sways but never falls, balanced on the moment between departure and arrival.

inscription: check-in is not a beginning, it is a place where endings learn to wait

file.name: Reception_Log_Simultaneous_Dates.txt
file.note: Every arrival date is today. The handwriting is consistent but the ink keeps trying to flow upward instead of across the page, as if the register cannot decide which direction time is moving.
